property_summary: When given matching non-empty arrays, C.transfer returns true and performs exactly tos.length external transferFrom calls with msg.sender as the from-address; it reverts when the array lengths differ.
For matching non-empty single-element arrays, C.transfer returns true and performs exactly one external transferFrom call with msg.sender (the caller contract) as from and the given to/value.
A call to C.transfer with matching non-empty arrays of length n returns true and makes exactly n external transferFrom callbacks to the caller.
For single-element matching arrays, C.transfer returns true and performs exactly one transferFrom callback with msg.sender as from.
C.transfer always reverts when the input arrays are empty, regardless of the target contract address.
For any valid non-zero, non-self contract_address and matching non-empty tos/vs arrays, transfer performs the per-element calls and returns true.
C.transfer must revert when the tos and vs arrays have different lengths, even if contract_address is valid and non-empty arrays are given.
C.transfer reverts when both arrays are empty (tos.length == vs.length == 0), even with a valid contract_address.
C.transfer reverts whenever contract_address is address(0) or the address of C itself, regardless of the arrays.
C.transfer always reverts when the vs array is empty while tos is non-empty, even for a valid contract_address.
C.transfer reverts whenever the tos and vs arrays have different lengths or are empty, and returns true otherwise.
